first.raw_text:
Town of Amherst - Public Works
4 Boltwood Avenue, Amherst, MA

NOTICE TO RESIDENTS

Juniper Lane will be repaved during the week of
December 7, 2026. Please do not park on the street
between 7 AM and 5 PM on those days.

There is no charge to residents. No action is needed.

Questions: call Public Works at 413-555-0120.
